purpose: Input manifest of the final weapon residual convergence. Audit evidence only: no runtime module reads it and it does not feed the 5D-H closure census. BLOCKED rows are guarded by tripwires that fail the day the missing subsystem appears.

subpasses.I-D-B: weapon durability, construction, mounting, upgrades and size-derived wielding
subpasses.I-D-C: special activation, resources and remote operation
subpasses.I-D-D: poison coating and unresolved damage semantics
subpasses.I-D-E: weapon / feat / talent relationships and remaining certification
subpasses.I-D-F: reload / ammo-resource special cases (PROPOSED subpass: the I-D handoff names no owner for these 12 keys; needs product approval)

partialOrUnconsumed.3b.profile.conditional: I-D-E (per-condition PROMPT / AUTO policy already classified by 5D-E)

skill-hook-unwired.note: EquipmentSkillHookResolver (the equipment -> Extra Skill Use bonus authority) has no importer, and only reads items of type "equipment"

skill-hook-equipment-only.note: the resolver ignores weapon items, so a weapon-carried skill bonus has no reader

no-stealth-state.note: no hidden / revealed-position state on actors or tokens

no-visibility-geometry.note: no line-of-sight / visibility geometry; combat code only consumes caller-supplied booleans (context.lineOfSight)

no-persistent-area-zone.note: the only scene-region / template creation is the droid sheet (unrelated); no persistent area-effect zone owner exists

no-deaf-rule.note: no deafness-based damage immunity exists in the combat code (the Deafened status icon and IMMUNE_DEAFNESS rule live elsewhere and gate no damage)

rows.missingSubsystem: actor / token stealth + revealed-position state
rows.owner: I-D-A2 / I-D-A3 (architecture design first; no implementation without a reviewed proposal)
rows.reason: Xerrol Nightstinger: firing does not end Stealth / reveal position. The system has no hidden / revealed state for firing to leave unchanged.

rows.missingSubsystem: persistent area-effect zone + visibility geometry
rows.owner: I-D-A2 / I-D-A3 (architecture design first; no implementation without a reviewed proposal)
rows.reason: Gas Grenade lingering cloud (triggeredEffects lingering-gas-concealment, duration until-end-of-attacker-next-turn): concealment is MUTUAL across the blast boundary and inside the 4-square blast. The attacker-next-turn lifecycle already exists (outcome-effects durationPlan, used by Flash Canister), but it hangs a status on an ACTOR; the cloud has no actor to hang on and needs a placed zone plus an inside / outside / across-boundary visibility test. The I-C-A impact outcome (CT -2 / Evasion -1) is already implemented and must not be reapplied.

rows.missingSubsystem: visibility / line-of-sight geometry
rows.owner: I-D-A2 / I-D-A3 (architecture design first; no implementation without a reviewed proposal)
rows.reason: Mortar Launcher: line of sight is traced from a point 20 squares above the launcher. The system takes line of sight as a caller-supplied boolean; there is no geometry to move the origin of.

Gas Grenade: the same immunity is carried by the condition-track-effect triggered effect, which the I-C-A ct-rider already executes. (The lingering cloud is a separate triggered effect; see gasConcealmentDuration.)

rows.missingSubsystem: persistent area-effect zone + visibility geometry
rows.owner: I-D-A2 / I-D-A3 (architecture design first; no implementation without a reviewed proposal)
rows.reason: Smoke Grenade: the cloud provides concealment for durationRounds (10). A cloud is a placed area that persists and is tested against token positions; the system has no persistent area-effect owner and no visibility / line-of-sight geometry (combat code only accepts a caller-supplied concealment option and a context.lineOfSight boolean).

rows.missingSubsystem: radiation exposure state / hazard area
rows.owner: I-D-A2 / I-D-A3 (architecture design first; no implementation without a reviewed proposal)
rows.reason: Radiation Grenade: exposes creatures to Moderate radiation for damage and Treat Injury purposes. Exposure has no state to set and no area to persist in.

rows.missingSubsystem: sensor-scan detection flow
rows.owner: I-D-A2 / I-D-A3 (architecture design first; no implementation without a reviewed proposal)
rows.reason: Wrist Blaster: a sensor scan for weapons detects it on a DC 25 Use Computer check. No sensor-scan flow exists to pit the scanner against a carried weapon.

rows.missingSubsystem: actor / token stealth + revealed-position state
rows.owner: I-D-A2 / I-D-A3 (architecture design first; no implementation without a reviewed proposal)
rows.reason: Xerrol Nightstinger: the shot is invisible to the eye. Needs the observers' perception of an attack to be a modelled event; no such state exists.

rows.missingSubsystem: noise / hearing event model
rows.owner: I-D-A2 / I-D-A3 (architecture design first; no implementation without a reviewed proposal)
rows.reason: Vibrorapier: silent operation. There is no noise or hearing event for a weapon to suppress.
